Read this first

  1. These are claims, not our measurements. Each publisher ran its own test. A lower KLD on one card is not evidence of a better file than a higher KLD on another.
  2. Methods rarely match. Publishers use different reference models (BF16, their own Q8_0, someone else's Q8_0), different text, context lengths and tools. Each row shows its reference; the cards below give the rest.
  3. Sizes mean different things. Sizes are as published on each card: download size, GPU memory or a single file. GiB figures are converted to GB. Vision and MTP weights are included by some publishers and not by others; each row says which size it is.

Compare quants inside one measurement

Every point in a set was measured the same way by the same party, so points in one set can be compared with each other; points from different sets cannot. Your ticks carry across sets, so you can follow a quant through every set that measured it. Quants that publish no comparable numbers are listed under Repos without extracted claims.

Quants

When one publisher measured several

These are the only tables where different publishers' files went through the same test. They are still one party's measurement, often of competitors.

How this was built

We listed every repository Hugging Face tags as a quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (1220 on 2026-10-17) and saved each raw README.md at its pinned commit into a local ledger, so nothing is re-fetched. Cards that reproduce another publisher's numbers are detected by comparing claim lines across all cards and are not counted as independent measurements. Results published only as chart images were transcribed from their labels and checked against the marker positions in the image. Numbers were extracted with the line they came from, then a script confirmed that 4981 published values appear verbatim on their cited lines (0 failures). For every card that carried measured claims at the first pass (196 of 1220), a second reader re-extracted the numbers without seeing our data, and disagreements were resolved against the source text; the remaining cards were each read in full by one reader. Rows a card quotes from elsewhere are marked "quoted" and are not counted as measurements; rows measured on a different model are left out (0). File sizes without a card figure come from Hugging Face's file listing at the same commit.

Cards for this model were captured through the Hugging Face connector on 18 Oct 2026 and are pinned by the SHA-256 of their exact text, not by commit. Source links point to the current card, which may have changed since capture.

Not covered: claims made only off-site or only in images, 14 repos whose cards are gated (access denied to our account), repos the Hub search did not return, and repos created or changed after 2026-10-17. Found an error or a new quant? Open an issue or pull request; each claim lives in a plain data file with its source line.

QFF (Quant Fidelity Frontier): what publishers claim, pinned to the line they said it · data captured 2026-10-17 · claims belong to their publishers · source and data · Support QFF (sponsor policy)
